Usage:
  badge-api check [flags]

Flags:
      --all-repositories string   Run checks against all repositories in the specified git base URL (example: https://gitlab.opencode.de)
  -h, --help                      help for check
      --output string             Stores sarif report in file (only when using --repository)
      --repository string         Run checks against a specific repository. Required if --all-repositories is not set

Global Flags:
  -l, --log-level string   Set the log level. Options are: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
